sub_answers.text: Results of each of the 12 shows were determined by a 50/50 combination of votes from a jury panel and public televoting.[d40165141s3p0] The jury votes in all shows consisted of a combination of a Lithuanian jury panel and an international jury panel.[d40165141s3p0] From the second show to the semi-final the Lithuanian panel members came to a consensus to assign one set of points, while the international panel members each assigned points in descending order for their favourites and least favourites.[d40165141s3p0] The public televote ranking was converted to points from 1-8, 10 and 12 based on the number of competing artists in the respective show.[d40165141s3p0]

sub_answers.sub_question: What tie-breaking procedures and qualification criteria were specified for advancing between heats, semifinals, and the final?
sub_answers.text: Ties in the elimination shows and the semi-final were decided in favour of the entry that received the most votes from the public.[d40165141s3p0] In the final, a tie would be decided in favour of the entry that was awarded the most points by the jury.[d40165141s3p0] The competition eliminated artists across shows (five eliminated in second and third shows, one eliminated each show from fourth to tenth, leaving three artists for the final) and reduced 16 songs down to three by the tenth show, with the semi-final selecting the single winning song from those three and the final selecting the winning artist-song combination from the remaining three artists.[d40165141s3p0]

sub_answers.text: 2023 and it was organised by the Lithuanian broadcaster LRT [d72194381s3p0][d72194381s1p0]. The competition used a multi‑show televised format with two heats, two semi‑finals and a final, and results in each show were determined by a 50/50 combination of a jury panel and public televoting with tie breaks decided in favour of the jury [d72194381s3p0]. The 2023 edition consisted of five shows in total: two heats, two semi‑finals and a final, and the final was held on 18 February 2023 [d72194381s3p0][d72194381s8p0]. All shows except the final were pre‑recorded earlier in the week before their airdates, while the final was broadcast live [d72194381s8p0].

Detail the structure of that year’s Lithuanian selection: how many preliminary heats or rounds were held (name them if different), how many contestants competed in each heat, how many acts advanced to the semifinals (if applicable), how many semifinalists there were, and the total number of acts that competed in the final and the dates of those stages.
sub_answers.text: The first two shows were heats, each featuring 15 entries, with the top ten entries from each heat advancing directly from those shows [d72194381s3p0]. The remaining 20 entries were placed into two semi‑final shows (the third and fourth shows) with ten entries in each semi‑final and the top five from each semi‑final advancing to the final [d72194381s3p0]. The final therefore featured ten competing entries, being the ten qualifiers from the heats and semi‑finals, and took place on 18 February 2023 [d72194381s3p0][d72194381s8p0]. The jury panel comprised five members in the heats and semi‑finals and seven members in the final [d72194381s5p0].
